c0-frame.title: Frame the cycle
c0-frame.imperative: Cycle 3 = continued refine; user declined ripeness ('still thematically getting our bearings'). Threads from user corrections: (1) two-stage decomposition - relative solve re-anchored on a field-car state (cake-and-eat-it); (2) noise taxonomy - modelable physics (density) vs structured evolution (track rubbering, within-weekend) vs residual common-mode vs car signal; (3) circuit fingerprint rebuild (corners + straights + ordering) as first-class descriptor, regime-share falls out, capability vector may reshape. Record pass when framed.
c0-frame.finding: Flavor = refine (continued; ripeness declined - 'still thematically getting our bearings'). Threads: two-stage relative+field-car decomposition; noise taxonomy (modelable physics vs structured evolution vs residual common-mode vs signal); circuit fingerprint rebuild (corners+straights+ordering) with capability-vector reshape implication. User amendments recorded on board.

q1.title: Stage-1 as an explicit weekend-state model: field-car + evolution latents with car deltas?
q1.imperative: Pin whether stage-1's coarse math model explicitly carries (a) modeled physics (density from measured pressure), (b) a smooth track-evolution latent within session/weekend, (c) a field-car state re-anchoring the relative deltas. Ask with recommendation; record as finding.
q1.finding: CONFIRMED: stage-1 = weekend-state model carrying four layers explicitly - (1) explained physics (density from measured pressure, mass/fuel), (2) structured evolution (smooth within-session grip latent), (3) field-car common-mode state (re-anchors relative deltas, accumulates absolute story), (4) car signal (deltas) - each term observation-backed, honest sigma per layer. x4's relative-vs-absolute result becomes the FLOOR this model must beat.

q2.title: Circuit fingerprint rebuild and the capability-vector reshape
q2.imperative: Pin the structural direction: shallow join (five global views x separate circuit descriptor) vs deep unification (capability fitted on shared corner/straight unit classes; fingerprint = time-weighted composition + ordering; regime shares fall out). Ask with recommendation; record as finding.
q2.finding: UNIFIED BASIS, NOT ZONE MATRIX: method (shared segmentation vocabulary) correct, BUT do not shard the car into per-zone independent capabilities - zones share explainable physics (exit traction correlates with entry braking grip via the same tyre/grip basis); a car x zone-class matrix would insert magic where there is explainable correlation. ROLE OF FINGERPRINT: observability router - it tells you WHICH views/evidence are relevant where (straights carry no cornering/grip evidence), while the solve targets ONE underlying physical basis across the entire lap. Circuit pace prediction = shared basis x circuit composition.

q3.title: Driver utility in the unified-basis picture
q3.imperative: Pin where driver utility lives: solved on the same basis (driver as per-unit-class modifier of the car envelope) vs residual after the car model; race-history prior placement. Ask with recommendation; record as finding.
q3.finding: DRIVER UTILITY: same-basis as STARTING POINT (confirmed). Nuances: utility expresses differently per axis - power-to-weight should have ~zero utility loss, but style dimensions may exist (e.g. how quickly the driver gets on power); most utility likely lives in corners (may make the concern moot); be mindful about what 'the driver is accessing' means. Open evolutions: per-view tweaks, or a DELTA BASIS the driver actually accesses. UNIFICATION INTENT CONFIRMED via x7: multiple views of the same parameters = information that must be used to REDUCE UNCERTAINTY, not left as independent fits.

x7.title: Excursion x7: current five-view parameter basis + dropped correlations map
x7.imperative: Background research excursion; brief excursions/x7-basis-map-brief.md. Record scoped verdict on return.
x7.finding: BASIS MAP: 5 views, each a 2-param fit (mean + <=2x2 within-view cov). DUPLICATIONS/FRACTURES: (1) mechanical grip measured 3x independently (lateral g-units / braking / traction m/s2) - zero coupling, zero stored correlation, friction-circle relationship never even tested for car-to-car covariance; (2) CdA solved twice (PowerDrag, Coast cross-check-by-eyeball) + point-pinned into Braking/Traction with one-directional Jacobian propagation (cda_frontier_jacobian - a reusable coupling mechanism); coast-vs-powerdrag CdA correlation irrecoverable from stored data; (3) theta_R measured by Coast but deliberately walled off (powertrain-contaminated, documented decision) - cold constant used everywhere else; (4) STARKEST FRACTURE: a_long is TWO different numbers - Braking uses the decoupled Kalman-RTS filter (WIRED), Traction/PowerDrag/Coast still use clean_longitudinal_from_raw (#523/#546 HONEST-NULL held them back); (5) HIDDEN SHARED NOISE: Braking/Traction/Lateral share the same smoothed trajectory (sample_cache) so their errors are correlated, but each bootstrap pretends independence. Covariance blobs = within-view ONLY; no cross-view structure persisted anywhere. Existing seams toward shared basis: decoupled-1D [E_total,F_vehicle] state (generalization attempted+diagnosed), outer loop Plan-7 cyclic coupling (currently 1-round DAG), cda_frontier_jacobian. Scoped: code-truth map; recoverability stated per item; no design proposed.

consolidation.summary: Cycle 3 (refine) consolidated. Themes settled: (1) stage-1 = four-layer weekend-state model (explained physics incl. density-from-measured-pressure / structured within-session evolution / field-car common-mode re-anchoring relative deltas / car signal), each layer observation-backed with honest sigma - x4's relative-vs-absolute result is the floor to beat; (2) unified physical basis solved across the whole lap, fingerprint (corners+straights+ordering) = observability router not partition; no car x zone matrix; x7 basis map = concrete pull-together list (grip triplet coupling test, a_long reconciliation, CdA joint fit, shared-trajectory noise, cross-view covariance persistence); (3) driver utility on the same basis as starting point, per-axis expression nuance noted (style dims, corners-dominant), delta-basis evolution open. Remaining: spec-level design. Board current.
